lines.trans: To our first family get-together!
There is a lot to be said for coming out.
Camille, I believe in you!
I know that you have what it takes.
You can be a great agent.
I get on very well with Andrea.
My best auditions are thanks to you.
Without you, I would not be here.
Do you want to be my agent?
Hippolyte, you have been drinking, calm down.
This is my first glass, I am serious!
I do not know, this is too fast.
You have qualities, but it is too soon.
This is crazy! You do not support her.
You do not believe in your own children's talent!
